solution: Rotated the key with shopctl and restarted orders-api.

timeline.event: Payment API key expired. None. The expiry reminder went to an old mailbox.
Alert PaymentAuthFailures fired. On-call opened an incident.
On-call found the expired key with shopctl secrets describe. Paged the payments team on-call for the rotate permission.
Key rotated and orders-api restarted. Watched the 401 rate fall to zero.
Card payments working again. Closed the incident.
summary: The key expiry reminder went to an unmonitored mailbox, so the key expired unnoticed. Nothing alerted on keys close to expiry. fix: Rotated the key with shopctl and restarted orders-api.

root_causes: The key expiry reminder went to an unmonitored mailbox, so the key expired unnoticed.
Nothing alerted on keys close to expiry.
